applies_to: VTS RH+T-SENS-D-MODRTU duct humidity and temperature transducer (Sensirion SHT31-DIS-B), manual ver. 2.0 (11.2021).
summary: A duct humidity and temperature transducer from VTS with a 0-5/0-10 V humidity output and an RS-485 Modbus RTU port. Humidity, temperature, a fixed test value and sensor status are plain 16-bit holding registers; address, baud rate, parity and stop bits are changed by writing a password, command and parameter.

addressing.note: The register map prints hex addresses starting at 0x0000, and the DEV_ID and SOFT_VER sections give 'addr=11=0x000B' and 'addr=12=0x000C', so the printed value is the wire address.

source.title: Humidity Transducer RH+T-SENS-D-MODRTU
source.pages: p. 7-8 DIP switches, p. 10 register map, p. 11 command table and DEV_ID, p. 12 SOFT_VER and functions, p. 14 byte order

notes: All registers are 16-bit; there are no 32-bit values.

Command parameters: 1 = address 1-247 (default 1); 2 = baud code 24/48/96/192/384/576/1152 for 2400-115200 bit/s (default 192 = 19200); 3 = parity 0 none (default), 1 even, 2 odd; 4 = stop bits 1 (default) or 2; 6 = 1 software reset of the device, 2 reset of the sensor module.
Commands can be sent as one FC16 write of password + command + parameter, or as single writes with the password written last.
Reserved registers 0x0006-0x0009 read 0 and are not listed. Reading an address outside the map returns exception 02.
The DIP switches can override baud rate, parity and address; they are read only at power-up or after RESET.

registers.name: TEST_VAL_REG
registers.description: Always reads 1000 (0x03E8); use it to check the link.

registers.name: PASS_REG (password)
registers.description: Writing 1234 (0x04D2) runs the command in COMMAND_REG/PARAM_REG.

registers.name: COMMAND_REG
registers.description: Command number; set to 0xEEEE after a bad parameter.

registers.name: DEV_ID_REG (device identification)
registers.description: Bits 11-15 device family, 9-10 hardware version, 4-8 type, 0-1 duct/room.

integration.summary: Read holding registers 0-2 with FC03: humidity in 0.1 %RH, temperature in 0.01 °C (signed) and the 1000 test value; check STATUS_REG (0x000A) for a sensor fault.
integration.enable: Modbus RTU is always on. Set the address on the right DIP switch (binary, 1-247) or by command; left DIP switches 3-6 pick fixed parity/baud or 'use software settings'.
quirks: Configuration only runs when the password register is written with 1234.
Fixed parity choice 'no parity, 2 stop bits' exists on the DIP switch.
setup: Switch on the built-in 120 ohm terminator (left DIP 1) at the line ends.
Restart the transducer after changing DIP switches.
gotchas: The analogue output only carries humidity; temperature is Modbus only.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
